PROJECT_PURPOSE.value: Canonical source of the Artisyn Harness — AI-first engineering lifecycle system (skills, agents, conventions) running this platform's own development, bootstrapped into other projects via .canonical-implementation-harness/ (versioned ZIP under releases/harness-bootstrap/, installed with /harness-bootstrap launch). Also ships the ADLC Discovery Tool docs site.
